title: Correct freshness and inferred-unit evidence labels
objective: The live clock and scientific evidence labels agree across cards, detail and APIs.
outcome: Request evaluation time reaches freshness projection; inferred unit tags remain search aids; catalog-metadata checks stay distinct from payload checks.

commits.subject: Use an explicit observation clock
commits.instructions: Inject request evaluation time through the public service into freshness projection while preserving deterministic frozen-clock evaluation. Do not mutate immutable source observations.
commits.verification: A September 10 fixture with a September 5 deadline is overdue; before-deadline and invalid/missing dates remain distinct.

commits.subject: Stop promoting inferred tags
commits.instructions: Replace researcherGuidance typical-unit mapping from unit_of_analysis with the explicit observation-grain claim. Show inferred categories only as search aids.
commits.verification: The audited HCRIS fixture keeps grain unresolved until supported evidence exists; card/detail/machine evidence states match.

commits.subject: Explain freshness scope in the UI
commits.instructions: Render last successful metadata check, latest attempt and stale status together; distinguish catalog metadata from payload checks. Keep the current visual components.
commits.verification: Advance a clock fixture without rebuilding the corpus and verify UI/API status changes while evidence hashes remain stable.

commits.subject: Correct freshness projection, trusted clock, and grain claims
commits.instructions: Complete R005-1 through R005-4: one freshness projection on search, browse, numeric browse and dataset lookup; trusted server clock with explicit injected clocks only; unknown observations are not successful checks; inferred/unavailable grain is not a resolved typical unit. Do not weaken the WP11 gate.
commits.verification: Controller semantics replay has ten passing cases; owned freshness/web/retrieval/wp1 checks pass; npm run test:worker remains failed-closed on WP11 historical pins.
